Title: Lunara Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: Hotfix 15.4.39709 (December 21, 2015), fixing a Gate-trapping bug after certain Abilities as well as talent and cooldown bugs for Thrall and The Butcher.
Highlights: Hotfix 15.4.39709 (December 21, 2015), fixing a Gate-trapping bug after certain Abilities as well as talent and cooldown bugs for Thrall and The Butcher.
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could cause Heroes to become stuck inside a Gate after using certain Abilities.

=== Heroes: The Butcher ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could grant excessive cooldown reduction to Ruthless Onslaught.

=== Heroes: Thrall ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Selecting the Rabid Wolves or Grace of Air Talents will no longer prevent Thrall from gaining stacks of Frostwolf Resilience when enemies are hit by Feral Spirit or Windfury.

General: • Fixed an issue that could cause Heroes to become stuck inside a Gate after using certain Abilities.
Heroes: The Butcher: • Fixed an issue that could grant excessive cooldown reduction to Ruthless Onslaught.
Heroes: Thrall: • Selecting the Rabid Wolves or Grace of Air Talents will no longer prevent Thrall from gaining stacks of Frostwolf Resilience when enemies are hit by Feral Spirit or Windfury.
